events.title: July 15th Demo Bug Fix
events.summary: Heads up: Transferring save files on this build is kind of wonky! It's HIGHLY recommended to manually transfer them over yourself before installing this update. You can do so via right clicking the demo -> Manage -> Browse local files -> save -> and copying ALL the files over to a safe place before updating, and then putting it back in the save folder. events.title: A Case of Missing Identity's Demo is Live!!
events.summary: Hi all! Did you know it's the 1 year anniversary of my first game, Veins Like Tapeworms?To celebrate, I'M RELEASING ACOMI'S DEMO! That's right, this demo is finally LIVE! With over 25,000 words of content - Act 1 and the first half of Act 2, all 5 Distortions to meet, and so on and so forth - you're sure to have at least a moderately decent time with what I've been working on for a solid 6 months now.
